description: NaSrTbSeO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent TbO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SeO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.86 Å. Sr is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent TbO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SeO₆ octahedra. All Sr-O bond lengths are 2.86 Å. Tb is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form TbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SeO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Tb-O bond lengths are 2.21 Å. Se is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form SeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TbO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Se-O bond lengths are 1.82 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sr, one Tb, and one Se atom.
